import numpy as np
def equation(eps, T, params):
    p=params
    L=np.log(eps)
    return (p[0] + p[1]*T + p[2]/T + p[3]/eps + p[4]*T/eps + p[5]*np.sqrt(eps)*T**3
            + p[6]*L*T**4/eps + p[7]*eps*T**3 + p[8]*L*T**2 + p[9]*T**2
            + p[0]*0 + 0.0)
